name: Happy Bear 29
author: bociKond
description: Gradient rounded dark green button that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border changes and opacity changes. On focus, opacity changes and it scales.
html:
<button class="border-green-100 hover:border-green-200 text-green-900 rounded-lg border-4 cursor-pointer px-8 py-3 font-bold -skew-x-12 bg-gradient-to-bl from-green-400 to-green-300 opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:scale-105 transition-all duration-300 font-sans">
      Button
    </button>
